content:
Track: SQL Fundamentals for Data Analysts
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to SQL and Structured Query Language
    - Lesson 2: Creating and Manipulating Tables with SQL
    - Lesson 3: Basic SELECT Statements and WHERE Clauses
    - Lesson 4: JOIN Operations in SQL
    - Lesson 5: Using GROUP BY and Aggregate Functions in SQL
    - Lesson 6: Subqueries and Derived Tables
    - Lesson 7: Advanced Filtering with SQL (LIKE, BETWEEN, IN)
    - Lesson 8: Understanding NULL values and handling missing data in SQL
    - Lesson 9: Complex Query Optimization and Best Practices
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to Database Design and Normalization

   Track: Python for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Intro to Python and Jupyter Notebooks
    - Lesson 2: Variables, Types, and Operators in Python
    - Lesson 3: Lists, Tuples, and Dictionaries in Python
    - Lesson 4: Control Structures (loops and conditionals) in Python
    - Lesson 5: Functions and Modules in Python
    - Lesson 6: Data Manipulation with Pandas Library
    - Lesson 7: Data Visualization with Matplotlib Library
    - Lesson 8: Introduction to Data Cleaning and Handling Missing Values
    - Lesson 9: Reading and Writing Files using Python
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to Regular Expressions (regex) in Python

   Track: Intermediate SQL for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Advanced Joins (OUTER, LEFT OUTER, RIGHT OUTER, FULL OUTER)
    - Lesson 2: CASE, COALESCE and IF-THEN-ELSE in SQL
    - Lesson 3: Subqueries with Self-Joins
    - Lesson 4: Advanced Grouping and Window Functions (RANK(), ROW_NUMBER())
    - Lesson 5: Using Transactions and Stored Procedures in SQL
    - Lesson 6: Introduction to Database Indexes and Optimization Techniques
    - Lesson 7: Working with JSON data in SQL using JSON functions
    - Lesson 8: Understanding ACID properties and MVCC concepts in databases
    - Lesson 9: Querying large datasets using techniques like Sampling and Partitioning
    - Lesson 10: Best practices for writing efficient, maintainable SQL queries

   Track: Data Visualization with Python (Advanced)
    - Lesson 1: Creating Bar Charts and Histograms in Matplotlib
    - Lesson 2: Building Scatter Plots and Heatmaps
    - Lesson 3: Using Seaborn Library for Statistical Graphics
    - Lesson 4: Creating Time Series Plots and Forecasting with Matplotlib
    - Lesson 5: Map-based Data Visualization using Folium and GeoPandas
    - Lesson 6: Interactive Dashboards with Plotly and Dash
    - Lesson 7: Building Interactive Maps with Leaflet.js
    - Lesson 8: Integrating Third-party APIs for Data Visualization (Google Maps, OpenWeatherMap)
    - Lesson 9: Data Storytelling and Communication in Visualizations
    - Lesson 10: Best Practices for Creating Effective and Engaging Visualizations

   Track: Introduction to Machine Learning (Python)
    - Lesson 1: Basics of Machine Learning Algorithms
    - Lesson 2: Supervised Learning (Regression, Classification)
    - Lesson 3: Unsupervised Learning (Clustering, Dimensionality Reduction)
    - Lesson 4: Evaluating and Optimizing Machine Learning Models
    - Lesson 5: Working with Machine Learning Libraries (Scikit-learn, TensorFlow)
    - Lesson 6: Time Series Analysis and Predictive Modeling
    - Lesson 7: Ensemble Methods in Machine Learning
    - Lesson 8: Introduction to Neural Networks and Deep Learning
    - Lesson 9: Natural Language Processing (NLP) with Python
    - Lesson 10: Putting it All Together: Project-based Machine Learning Implementation
